findings.title: Dated screening amendment incorrectly reported absent
findings.page_quote: contains no dated Amendment section, so no amendment has been registered for this topic.
findings.why: The committed protocol contains a dated amendment, which is also displayed immediately above this reason.
findings.fix: Recognize dated amendment headings with introductory words and render this amendment.

findings.title: Suppressed harms are described as pooled outcomes
findings.page_quote: Every trial row that enters a pooled outcome of this review

evidence.quote: "basis": "No quantitative safety conclusion while source-reporting trials remain unresolved"

findings.why: The table's “Pooled in” column includes Any adverse events and Serious adverse events, although both syntheses are suppressed. Extracted trial rows are being presented as contributions to served pools.
findings.fix: Distinguish extracted outcomes from pooled outcomes and show the suppression status for these harms.

findings.title: Comparator explanation retains an obsolete single-trial account
findings.page_quote: k=1 CONTRIBUTING, not a complete-evidence claim: PARADIGM-HF supplies the only EXTRACTABLE primary-outcome estimate here; 7 records screened in and 6 are declared absent for this pooled number.
findings.why: The current outcome includes an extracted PARALLEL-HF estimate alongside PARADIGM-HF, and its two-trial pool is refused for direction conflict. The comparator prose describes an earlier evidence state.
findings.fix: Update the source comparator explanation to reflect both extracted trials and the current pool refusal.

findings.title: Refused synthesis is labeled as pooled
findings.page_quote: Every trial row that enters a pooled outcome of this review

evidence.quote: "basis": "no pooled claim is emitted because the pooled row is refused"

findings.why: Both trials appear under “Pooled in,” although the sole outcome has no served pooled result.
findings.fix: Label these as extracted individual results and display the pool-refusal status.

findings.title: Single-trial effects labeled as pooled estimates

evidence.quote: Single included trial that reported this outcome — the estimate is that trial's own effect; no random-effects pooling (tau^2, HKSJ and prediction interval are not applicable at k=1).

findings.why: The Analysis table and forest plots call the k=1 results pooled, while the recorded method and Results tab explicitly describe single-trial effects.
findings.fix: Use “Single-trial effect” in the tables and plots whenever k=1.

findings.title: Absence of a checkable claim is mistaken for absence of pooling
findings.page_quote: Nothing was pooled on this page, so the canonical-claim contradiction gate has nothing to check here

evidence.quote: "basis": "no significance/null-crossing claim is emitted for a refused k=2 HKSJ CI"

findings.why: A two-trial pooled point estimate is recorded and displayed. The refused confidence interval prevents a significance claim; it does not mean nothing was pooled.
findings.fix: State that no checkable significance/null-crossing claim is emitted because the k=2 interval is refused.
